subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should assistant reasoning and tool activity become visible by default in native macOS chat when the user has no stored preference?
rationale: Current macOS behavior hard-disables traces, while the PR introduces a persisted preference whose absent-value behavior enables them for existing and new users; code review cannot choose that disclosure and presentation default safely.

options.title: Preserve minimal default
options.body: Default traces off and let users explicitly enable the persisted toggle, preserving current behavior during upgrade.

options.title: Enable traces by default
options.body: Accept the new default-on presentation for all users without a stored preference and document the intentional behavior change.

options.title: Differentiate upgrade state
options.body: Keep existing installations off while enabling traces for demonstrably fresh installations through an explicit migration or initialization rule.

recommendation.title: Preserve minimal default
recommendation.body: Default traces off and let users explicitly enable the persisted toggle, preserving current behavior during upgrade.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the documented product owner and authored the default-on trace design in this branch.
